_comment: Gzipped bytes. Rule 11: nothing merges over the size budget. Raising a number here is a decision, not a formality — say why in the commit. Lowering one because the measurement got more honest is a decision too: see _rederived.
_shell: Everything a visitor downloads before choosing a game: the scripts every non-play route loads eagerly, from the build's own manifests. Does not grow when a game is added, so it is the number worth defending. Deferring work off this path into an async chunk now lowers it.
_onDemand: Everything else a player can pull that is not one game's own chunk: the play route's own scripts, plus anything reached by an import(). Nobody downloads it by arriving. Budgeted so that deferring is neither punished (it used to raise the shell) nor free.
_game: One game's own chunk — the marginal cost of the game a player actually picked.
_raised_2026_09_06: shellBytes 151552 -> 164864. Measured 162858 against the 150778 #2516 measured on main, so the batch adds 12080 B and leaves 2006 B of headroom. What the bytes buy: catalogue search, category chips, sort, favourites and recently-played (#83 #84 #85 #86 #87), the quick-play button (#163), mute and volume (#171), the haptics toggle (#135), the settings page (#91) and local export/import (#2448). Where they sit now, measured per chunk from the build manifests rather than inferred: the three chunks all thirteen non-play routes load are 143827 B, /games/ adds 3744 B for the browser and its filter logic, /settings/ 4869 B across two chunks for a route that did not exist before, /games/[slug]/ 2191 B, and a 3370 B chunk shared by eight routes. What was deliberately kept out, and this is the part worth defending: no client component imports catalogue.generated.ts, tiles.ts, GameCard/GameTile/TileSprite or registry.ts, so the catalogue's 60 kB of rule text and all 108 tiles stay server-rendered and reach the browser as finished markup rather than as script. No audio code is in the shell — grepping every shell chunk for createBufferSource, decodeAudioData and AudioContext finds nothing — and SoundToggle reaches lib/audio through import() rather than a top-level import to keep it that way as the header grows; that import() was measured as worth 1 byte today, so it is insurance rather than a saving, and it is recorded as insurance. Worth stating plainly: 4869 B of the rise is the /settings/ route's own chunk, which only a visitor who opens Settings ever downloads, and this guard counts it because the shell is the union over every non-play route. That is the same category the play route was moved out of in #2516 and the same argument would move any leaf route out. It is a change to what this guard measures, so it is not made here in the commit it would flatter; it is written down rather than taken.
_rederived: #2516, measured on main. shellBytes was 286720 against a measured 284876, but that measurement was 'every script that is not a game chunk'. Splitting it by what a browser actually fetches: 150778 shell + 37056 play-route + 97042 pages-router scripts that none of the 223 exported HTML files references and nobody ever downloads. 150778 + 37056 + 97042 = 284876 exactly, so nothing was dropped, only placed. The two budgets leave 774 B and 832 B of headroom — 1606 B in total against the 1844 B the old single budget had, so the honester measurement frees no slack, which is the condition #2516 sets on being fixed at all.
